# The rt.* intrinsics of std/native/rt.xo a backend does not lower, and why
# (internal/repotest TestRuntimeIntrinsicsLowered): `backend name reason`.
# A new intrinsic needs a lowering in each backend, or a line here.

arm64 any_of lowered by compiler/ssa itself (an intrinsic of the builder, no runtime call)
arm64 atomic_add lowered by compiler/ssa itself (an intrinsic of the builder, no runtime call)
arm64 atomic_max lowered by compiler/ssa itself (an intrinsic of the builder, no runtime call)
arm64 cast lowered by compiler/ssa itself (an intrinsic of the builder, no runtime call)
arm64 duration_parse layer 0 only: called from the WASI and Go backend arms of std/native/llrt and the portable prelude, which fold away on the native backends
